features.quote: Bounded turn budget (default 12), three end conditions
features.justification_quote: a budget is what makes the eval *terminate cheaply* and bounds cost per episode

features.quote: Ends on `give_up`, budget exhaustion, or 3 consecutive parse failures
features.justification_quote: Parse-failure cap prevents pathological no-op loops from burning the whole budget

features.quote: Explicit `give_up` tool + system-prompt permission to stop
features.justification_quote: we must give the model a *legitimate exit* so graceful give-up is achievable

features.quote: The system prompt tells the agent that stopping cleanly is a valid, good outcome
features.justification_quote: Without an exit, every model would be forced to either loop or violate the protocol
